svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
Tether the aircraft firmly before any spin-up.
Verify C2 heartbeat, attitude, tilt, and nozzle response on the ground.
Procedure pending the Rev T+ re-audit of guide Phases 4-11 (graphical-build-guide/WBS.md 1.5.6).
This card shows the Rev T+ architecture only; follow the authority documents named below.
Spinning EDFs and a free aircraft can cause serious injury. Keep all people clear of the duct plane and the flight area.
The landing gear is not flight-cleared; see card 08.
